from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    fg = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row)
          if value != grid[0][0]]
    top = min(r for r, _ in fg)
    bottom = max(r for r, _ in fg)
    left = min(c for _, c in fg)
    right = max(c for _, c in fg)
    for c in range(left, right + 1):
        if grid[top][c] == grid[0][0]:
            out[top][c] = 2
        if grid[bottom][c] == grid[0][0]:
            out[bottom][c] = 2
    for r in range(top, bottom + 1):
        if grid[r][left] == grid[0][0]:
            out[r][left] = 2
        if grid[r][right] == grid[0][0]:
            out[r][right] = 2
    return out
'''
p=programs/'task-d1a8699a.py'
p.write_text(source)
print(p, p.exists())
